attempted_args.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer
Asset type: 74x100 low-resolution medieval RPG dialogue portrait, last targeted substantive redraw.
Primary request: Edit reference 1 using the following concentrated fixes while preserving the character identity shown in reference 2. Draw freshly with the coarse intentional pixel-cluster grammar of references 3-6. Reference 1 is the first portrait to revise; reference 2 is the identity master; 3 Mara, 4 Iwo, 5 Leiya, 6 Tore are style-only examples.
Subject and invariants: Folan is a man in his forties, an ordinary private creditor. Lock his receding temples, swept-back salt-and-pepper gray hair, short gray beard and moustache, broad projecting nose, substantial cheekbones, warm weathered complexion, same three-quarter viewer-left view, muted aubergine inner tunic and brown straight-front outer garment. Do not age him further. Flatten the raised inner brow so the expression is practical, careful, mildly guarded, discussing rules; neither a sad frightened man nor a thug. Consolidate the fine bright gray hair and beard flecks into fewer large linked pixel masses. Keep the entire hair and ear silhouette.
MANDATORY VISUAL FIXES: First reduce both eye whites to tiny SHADOWED warm dark-gray/tan slits, only 1 or 2 logical pixels visible per eye, enclosed in dark upper lids. No ivory/white large patches, no wide eyes. Second REMOVE the long bare neck and broad bust. Bring the chin close to the neckline; bare neck below chin is only 4-6 logical rows. Clothing is a tiny narrow wedge occupying only the bottom 8-10 rows, no chest panel or deep neckline. Use the gained space for a LARGE FACE with clear coarse nose/cheek planes, not for padding. Third replace smooth shading and fine texture with big hard-edged connected pixel clusters, like the four portrait references. Keep age and identity readable.
Composition: exact 74:100 vertical aspect, oversized head, nearly full canvas, collar close to bottom. Entire top hair, ears and side hair remain whole, with 3 logical transparent pixels above and 2-3 pixels at each side. Real clearance must be present IN THE GENERATED SOURCE, no near-edge clipping. Do not shrink the head to fit a broad chest. Retain tiny transparent clearance below the silhouette.
Pixel medium: imagine drawing directly on a 74x100 grid and enlarging by nearest-neighbor only. 24-32 muted earth colors, dark compact eye shapes, strong stepped outer contours, sculptural nose and cheekbone blocks, large contiguous flat fills. No painterly gradients, no anti-aliasing, smooth shading, micro-hatching, dithering, isolated speckles or glossy baby-doll beauty. Source may be an enlarged rendition, but each logical pixel cluster must be broad and deliberate.
Background: genuinely transparent alpha; opaque subject and transparent background. One portrait only. No props, hat, jewelry, background, cast shadow, halo, panel, text, labels, watermark, UI or decorative effects. Preserve garment color and character, change only the concentrated fixes above.
